thread:
maya: Quick heads-up — I opened a small PR to fix a couple of broken links and an outdated SDK snippet in the dedicated capacity provisioning guide. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/492
jon: Saw it — thanks. Which snippet is outdated?
maya: The Node SDK example for the reserve flow uses the old `createReservation` signature. We now use `client.dedicated.createReservation({})`. Also one Terraform example still references `reserved_pool_id` (renamed).
kevin: Oof. Those will confuse folks during onboarding. Can we add a short migration note + minimal Node + Python snippets?
maya: Exactly. Proposed Node snippet included in the PR:
```js
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood();
await client.dedicated.createReservation({
  capacity: 2,
  region: 'us-west-2',
});
```
Also planning a one-liner Python example.
lia: @jon can you review the SLA paragraph too? The PR touches the isolation paragraph and I want to ensure we don't change meaning.
jon: I'll take SLA + isolation wording. Quick question: do we still need the preemption note for reserved pools? That guidance might still apply.
alex: Suggestion: add a compatibility table mapping old keys -> new keys and a tiny migration snippet. That reduces copy/paste mistakes.
maya: Good call. I added a compact table and left a TODO flag in the PR for backporting. Also fixed an internal guide link: docs/internal/dedicated-onboarding.md -> /handbook/dedicated-onboarding
kevin: Can we include a troubleshooting bullet: "If you see 403 when creating a reservation, confirm org-level quota and that your role includes `dedicated.admin`"?
jon: :thumbsup: I'll tone the language and keep it actionable.
docs-bot: Automated check: broken-link-check passed; linter flagged 1 markdown heading style issue in docs/dedicated/provisioning.md
maya: Fixed the heading style. @kevin @lia can you confirm the SDK snippets run locally? I tested the Node snippet with a staging token and it worked.
kevin: Confirmed locally with staging token. Python snippet needed a small import tweak; sending a one-line patch.
lia: LGTM on isolation wording. I added one sentence about fallback routing when reserved capacity is exhausted so readers know behavior under contention.
maya: Plan: merge after jon's edits and kevin's patch. I'll backport to the v0.11 docs branch and add a changelog line under "migration notes".
alex: Could we tag this in the release notes as: "docs(dedicated): rename reserved_pool_id -> pool_id, update SDK examples and migration note"?
jon: Yes — I'll add that to the release draft.
maya: Thanks team :party_parrot: Will merge once CI is green.
docs-bot: PR merged to main by maya at 2045002120
